== Summary ==
Un joueur superieur! Jerome Janiztki, Lille, France, is his country's second Star Wars CCG World finalist. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Jerome Janiztki]].
